changes: Speed Test now runs for a 30-second measurement window for steadier readings.
Speed Test starts automatically after sign-in and shows a clickable floating running notice.
Speed Test now uses calibrated high-resolution gauges where the needle and arc share the same scale.
Download, upload, ping, jitter, and endpoint results are each shown once in a compact instrument layout.
Ping is shown as a point-to-point workstation-to-server route.
NAS health counts all retained local cache evidence files.
Portable release folder includes SHA256 and NAS publish/update CMD scripts.
JackPeek checks the NAS release manifest at startup and shows update status.
